senses.gloss: סֵפֶר מ׳ the Book M’ʿoni, name of a Pentateuch copy in Jerusalem in which מָעוֹן was written in place of מְעֹנָה (Deut. XXXIII, 27).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:2:12">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ספר מ׳</he>; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 356:1">Sifré Deut. 356</cite> <he>של מְעוֹנִים</he>; <cite ref="Tractate Soferim 6:4">Treat. Sof’rim VI, 4</cite> <he>ספר מעונה</he> (corr. acc.).
